hook.convey: one whole stretch from start = 0 to finish = 1; stopping exactly halfway → standing on a real spot → 0 and 1 have no name for it → fractions are numbers that live between 0 and 1

use.hi: Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai.
use.en: A cricket pitch: one stump at 0, the other at 1. The batsman stopped right in the middle; that spot has a number too.

use.hi: Ghar 0 par, school 1 kilometre par; school bus aadhe raaste mein ruki. Us jagah ka bhi number hota hai.
use.en: Home is at 0, school at 1 kilometre; the school bus stopped halfway. That spot has a number too.

use.hi: Game mein level ki progress 0 se 1 tak bharti hai; abhi aadhi bhari hai, beech ke ek number par.
use.en: In a game the level's progress fills from 0 to 1; right now it is half full, at a number in between.

explain.convey: 0 and 1 at the ends; one cut exactly in the middle → 2 equal gaps; the middle mark = 1/2 → 1/2 is a number with its own place, between 0 and 1, not at 2

viewCaption.hi: Yahan line ki jagah ek patti hai, do barabar gaps mein, aur ek gap rangin hai. Rangin gap patti ke shuru se theek beech tak jaata hai, jaise line par 0 se beech wale mark tak.
viewCaption.en: Here, in place of the line, there is a strip in two equal gaps, with one gap coloured. The coloured gap runs from the start of the strip to exactly the middle, like 0 to the middle mark on the line.

point.hi: Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2.
point.en: Here's a line from 0 to 1. There is one mark right in the middle, so the line now has 2 equal gaps. This mark is called 1/2.

pointAlt.hi: Ek roti ko theek beech se kaato toh do barabar hisse milte hain. Line par bhi beech wala mark 0 se 1 ko aise hi do barabar gaps mein baant-ta hai, isliye woh 1/2 hai.
pointAlt.en: Cut a roti right down the middle and you get two equal parts. The middle mark on the line splits 0 to 1 the same way, into two equal gaps, so it is 1/2.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: The other side of the line has 3 equal gaps. Which fraction is the first mark there?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line 3 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: If the line from 0 to 1 is cut into 3 equal gaps, which fraction is the first mark after 0?

simpler.hi: Beech wale mark ka naam line ke 2 barabar gaps se aaya tha. Ab doosri taraf ke gaps gino, aur pehle mark ka naam usi tarah rakho.
simpler.en: The middle mark got its name from the line's 2 equal gaps. Now count the gaps on the other side, and name the first mark the same way.

why.hi: doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par hai, yaani 1/3, 3 par nahi
why.en: the other side has 3 equal gaps, and the first mark is one gap from 0: 1/3, not 3

whyShort.hi: 3 barabar gaps, pehla mark ek gap par: 1/3
whyShort.en: 3 equal gaps; first mark one gap along: 1/3

whyAlt.hi: jaise 2 gaps wali line ka beech wala mark 1/2 tha, waise hi 3 gaps wali line par 0 se ek gap 3 mein se 1 hai, yaani 1/3
whyAlt.en: just as the middle mark of a 2-gap line was 1/2, on a 3-gap line one gap from 0 is 1 out of 3, that is 1/3

viewCaption.hi: Yahan do barabar lambi qatarein hain: pehli qatar do barabar gaps mein, ek gap rangin, aur doosri qatar teen barabar gaps mein, abhi bina rang ke.
viewCaption.en: Here are two rows of the same length: the first row in two equal gaps with one coloured, and the second row in three equal gaps, not coloured yet.

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar ka pehla gap ab rangin hai. Woh gap jahan khatam hota hai, wahi 1/3 hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech.
answerViewCaption.en: The second row's first gap is now coloured. Where that gap ends is 1/3, between 0 and 1.

simpler.hi: 0 se beech wale mark tak ek gap, aur wahan se 1 tak ek aur: dono gap ek jitne lambe. Do mein se pehla gap, isliye 1/2.
simpler.en: From 0 to the middle mark is one gap, and from there to 1 another: both gaps the same length. The first of two gaps, so 1/2.

explain.convey: same 0 to 1, now 6 marks inside → 7 equal gaps (gaps = marks inside + 1); bottom number = number of equal gaps in 0 to 1; first mark from 0 = end of 1 gap = 1/7; the name comes from gaps, not marks

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti saat barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai, 1/7. Line par chhe marks the, par gaps saat.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in seven equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured, 1/7. The line had six marks, but seven gaps.

point.hi: Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab us par 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7.
point.en: The same line from 0 to 1, but now it has 6 marks on it. Don't count the marks, count the gaps: 7 equal gaps. So the first mark after 0 is 1/7.

pointAlt.hi: 0 se chalo: har mark se pehle ek gap aata hai, toh 6 marks ke 6 gaps, aur aakhri mark ke baad 1 tak ek gap aur. Isliye 6 marks ke saath 7 gaps hain, aur 0 ke baad wala pehla mark 1/7 hai.
pointAlt.en: Walk from 0: there is a gap before each mark, so 6 marks give 6 gaps, and one more gap after the last mark up to 1. That's why 6 marks come with 7 gaps, and the first mark after 0 is 1/7.

prompt.hi: Ab line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Us taraf kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
prompt.en: Now look at the other side of the line: there are 7 marks there, all equally far apart. How many equal gaps are on that side?

why.hi: beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps
why.en: there's always one more gap than marks in between, so 7 marks make 8 gaps

whyShort.hi: marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps
whyShort.en: one more gap than marks: 7 marks, 8 gaps

whyAlt.hi: doosri taraf ke marks par chalkar gino: 0 se pehle mark tak ek gap, phir 7 marks mein se har mark ke baad ek gap, toh 1 + 7 = 8 gaps
whyAlt.en: walk along the marks on the other side and count: one gap from 0 to the first mark, then one gap after each of the 7 marks, so 1 + 7 = 8 gaps

simpler.hi: Doosri taraf ke gaps ek-ek karke gino: marks ke beech wale bhi, aur 0 ke baad wala aur 1 se pehle wala bhi.
simpler.en: Count the gaps on the other side one by one: the ones between marks, and also the one after 0 and the one before 1.

viewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar saat barabar gaps mein hai, uska pehla gap rangin. Doosri qatar utni hi lambi hai aur abhi bina rang ke; uske gaps line ki doosri taraf ke marks se bante hain.
viewCaption.en: The first row is in seven equal gaps, its first gap coloured. The second row is just as long and not coloured yet; its gaps come from the marks on the other side of the line.

simpler.hi: Line par 6 marks the aur 7 gaps. Gap marks ke beech bhi hote hain aur dono siron par bhi, isliye gaps hamesha marks se ek zyada.
simpler.en: The line had 6 marks and 7 gaps. Gaps are between the marks and also at both ends, so there is always one more gap than marks.

explain.convey: the same 0 to 1 in 8 equal gaps → more gaps than the 7 before → each gap smaller; 1/8 = first mark, right next to 0; 1/2 still the middle mark (4 of the 8 gaps); more equal gaps in the same whole → each gap shorter → 1/8 sits closer to 0 than 1/7 and 1/2

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti aath barabar gaps mein hai, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai, 1/8.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in eight equal gaps, and its first gap is coloured, 1/8.

point.hi: Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door.
point.en: Now the same 0 to 1, but the line has 8 equal gaps. More gaps, so each gap is smaller than before. The first mark is 1/8, one gap from 0.

pointAlt.hi: Do ek jaisi roti socho: ek 4 barabar hisson mein kati, ek 6 mein, toh 6 wali ka har hissa patla hai. Line par bhi gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota, aur pehla mark utna hi 0 ke paas.
pointAlt.en: Think of two identical rotis: one cut into 4 equal parts, one into 6, so each part of the 6 one is thinner. On a line too, the more gaps, the shorter each gap, and the closer the first mark is to 0.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
prompt.en: On the other side of the line, the same 0 to 1 is cut into 10 equal gaps. Which stops closer to 0: 1/8 or 1/10?

why.hi: 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas
why.en: a gap out of 10 is smaller than a gap out of 8, so 1/10 stops sooner, nearer 0

whyShort.hi: 10 gaps wala gap chhota, toh 1/10 pehle rukta hai
whyShort.en: a 1/10 gap is smaller, so 1/10 stops sooner

whyAlt.hi: ek hi deewar par do seedhiyaan socho, ek mein 8 barabar paydaan aur ek mein 10: 10 wali seedhi ka pehla paydaan zameen ke zyada paas hota hai, waise hi line par 1/10 pehle rukta hai, 0 ke zyada paas
whyAlt.en: picture two ladders against the same wall, one with 8 equal steps and one with 10: the 10-step ladder's first step is nearer the ground, and in the same way 1/10 stops first on the line, nearer 0

simpler.hi: 1/8 wala pehla gap aur 1/10 wala pehla gap ungli se naapo, aur dekho kaunsa chhota hai.
simpler.en: Measure the first 1/8 gap and the first 1/10 gap with your finger, and see which is shorter.

viewCaption.hi: Dhyan pehle gap par rakho: pehli qatar aath barabar gaps mein hai aur uska pehla gap rangin hai, doosri qatar utni hi lambi, das barabar gaps mein. Dono qataron ka baayan kinaara line ka 0 hai.
viewCaption.en: Keep your eye on the first gap: the first row is in eight equal gaps with its first gap coloured, and the second row, just as long, is in ten equal gaps. The left end of both rows is the line's 0.

simpler.hi: Line ke 8 barabar gaps ek-ek karke gino. Pehla mark pehle gap ke khatam hote hi aata hai.
simpler.en: Count the line's 8 equal gaps one by one. The first mark comes as soon as the first gap ends.

problem.hi: Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain.
problem.en: Home is at 0 and school at 1 kilometre. Along the way are 3 electric poles, equally spaced.

problemAlt.hi: Board ki line ko raasta samjho: 0 par ghar, 1 par school, aur beech ke marks khambe. Hum pehle gaps ginenge, phir dekhenge ki pehla khamba kitne gaps par hai.
problemAlt.en: Take the line on the board as the road: home at 0, school at 1, and the marks in between are the poles. First we count the gaps, then we see how many gaps away the first pole is.

simpler.hi: Pehle chhota socho: beech mein sirf 1 khamba hota, toh woh theek aadhe raaste par, 1/2 kilometre par hota. Ab 3 khambe hain, toh pehle yeh dekho ki woh raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein baant-te hain.
simpler.en: Start smaller: with just 1 pole in between, it would stand exactly halfway, at 1/2 kilometre. Now there are 3 poles, so first see how many equal gaps they cut the road into.

givens.hi: poora raasta 1 kilometre ka, aur beech mein 3 khambe
givens.en: a 1 kilometre road with 3 poles in between

find.hi: pehle khambe ki doori, kilometre mein
find.en: how far the first pole is, in kilometres

prompt.hi: 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
prompt.en: Into how many equal gaps do the 3 poles cut the road?

reask.hi: Ghar se school tak 1 kilometre ke raaste par 3 khambe barabar doori par hain; woh raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
reask.en: On the 1-kilometre road from home to school, 3 poles stand equally spaced; into how many equal gaps do they cut the road?

right.hi: Haan, 4 gap: dono siron par bhi ek-ek gap hai.
right.en: Yes, 4 gaps: there is a gap at each end too.

why.hi: pehle khambe se pehle aur aakhri ke baad bhi ek-ek gap hai
why.en: there is a gap before the first pole and one after the last

told.hi: 3 khambe raaste ko 4 barabar gaps mein kaatte hain: ghar se pehle khambe tak ek gap, aur aakhri khambe se school tak bhi ek.
told.en: 3 poles cut the road into 4 equal gaps: one gap from home to the first pole, and one from the last pole to school too.

simpler.hi: Ghar se chalna shuru karo aur har gap par ek gino: khambon ke beech wale bhi, aur dono siron wale bhi.
simpler.en: Start walking from home and count one for each gap: the ones between poles, and the ones at both ends too.

why.hi: khamba bas ek jagah hai; chalna gaps mein hota hai
why.en: a pole is just a spot; the walking happens in the gaps

told.hi: Doori gaps se naapte hain, khambon se nahi: khamba bas ek jagah hai, aur ghar se pehle khambe tak ka chalna ek gap hai.
told.en: Distance is measured in gaps, not poles: a pole is just a spot, and the walk from home to the first pole is one gap.

simpler.hi: Ghar se pehle khambe tak chalkar socho: tumhare pair kis cheez par chale, aur khamba kahan khada raha.
simpler.en: Walk from home to the first pole and think: what did your feet walk along, and where did the pole stand.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
prompt.en: Your turn: how many kilometres from home is the first pole?

reask.hi: 1 kilometre ka raasta 4 barabar gaps mein hai; pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
reask.en: A 1 kilometre road is in 4 equal gaps; how many kilometres from home is the first pole?

why.hi: raasta 4 barabar gaps mein kata hai aur pehla khamba theek ek gap par hai
why.en: the road is in 4 equal gaps and the first pole stands exactly one gap along

whyAlt.hi: 4 barabar gaps milkar poora 1 kilometre banate hain, toh ek gap 1 kilometre ka ek chauthai hai, yaani 1/4 kilometre
whyAlt.en: 4 equal gaps make the whole 1 kilometre, so one gap is one quarter of the kilometre, that is 1/4 kilometre

simpler.hi: Poora raasta 1 kilometre ka hai, aur woh 4 barabar gaps mein kata hai. Ek gap 1 kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, bas yahi socho.
simpler.en: The whole road is 1 kilometre, cut into 4 equal gaps. Just think what fraction of 1 kilometre one gap is.

answer.hi: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai
answer.en: the first pole is 1/4 kilometre from home

why.hi: 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai
why.en: with 4 equal gaps each gap is 1/4 kilometre, and the first pole stands exactly one gap from 0

viewCaption.hi: Is patti ko raasta samjho: baayan kinaara ghar, daayan kinaara school, aur beech ke teen marks teen khambe.

prompt.hi: 0 se 1 ki is line ko 10 marks ne barabar baanta hai. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: 10 marks split this line from 0 to 1 evenly. What fraction is the first mark after 0?

hindi.hi: Is line par 0 aur 1 ke beech 10 marks lage hain, sab ek-doosre se barabar door. Batao, 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
hindi.en: On this line 10 marks sit between 0 and 1, all equally far from each other. Tell me, which fraction is the mark closest to 0?

did.hi: 10 marks se bane gaps gine aur pehle mark ka naam rakha
