viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur sirf pehla gap rangin hai. Gaps ke beech ke marks wahi hain jo line par 0 aur 1 ke beech the; ab baayein kinaare se daayein kinaare tak saare gaps gino.
viewCaption.en: This strip is cut into equal gaps, and only the first gap is coloured. The marks between the gaps are the ones that sat between 0 and 1 on the line; now count every gap, from the left end to the right end.

why.hi: 10 marks se line ke 11 barabar gaps bante hain, aur pehla mark ek gap par hai, yaani 1/11
why.en: 10 marks make 11 equal gaps, and the first mark is one gap along, at 1/11

whyShort.hi: 10 marks se 11 gaps, pehla mark ek gap par
whyShort.en: 10 marks make 11 gaps; the first is one gap

whyAlt.hi: chhota karke dekho: 1 mark ho toh 2 gaps, 2 marks ho toh 3 gaps; isi tarah 10 marks ke 11 gaps, toh pehla mark 1/11
whyAlt.en: try it smaller: 1 mark gives 2 gaps, 2 marks give 3 gaps; the same way 10 marks give 11 gaps, so the first mark is 1/11

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 11 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai: yahi 1/11 hai. Line ke 10 marks ne hi ise 11 gaps mein baanta tha.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 11 equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured: that is 1/11. The line's 10 marks are what cut it into 11 gaps.

simpler.hi: Marks chhodo, gaps gino. 0 se 1 ki line par 10 marks se jitne gaps bane, wahi neeche wala number hai.
simpler.en: Forget the marks, count the gaps. On a line from 0 to 1, however many gaps the 10 marks make, that's the bottom number.

prompt.hi: Line ki ek taraf 4 barabar gaps hain, doosri taraf 12. Dono taraf ke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas wala mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: One side of the line has 4 equal gaps, the other side 12. Of the marks on both sides, which fraction is the mark nearest 0?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line ek taraf 4 barabar gaps mein kati hai, doosri taraf 12 mein; dono taraf ke marks mein 0 ke sabse paas kaunsa fraction hai?
reask.en: The line from 0 to 1 is cut into 4 equal gaps on one side and 12 on the other; of the marks on both sides, which fraction is nearest 0?

did.hi: 0 ke sabse paas wala mark pehchaana

viewCaption.hi: Do barabar lambi qatarein hain, pehli qatar chaar barabar gaps mein aur doosri barah mein. Dono qataron ka pehla gap, baayein kinaare se, dhyan se dekho.
viewCaption.en: There are two rows of the same length, the first row in four equal gaps and the second in twelve. Look closely at the first gap of each row, from the left end.

why.hi: 12 barabar gaps ka har gap 4 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/12 wala pehla mark 0 ke sabse paas hai
why.en: each of 12 equal gaps is shorter than each of 4, so the first mark, 1/12, is nearest 0

whyShort.hi: 12 gaps wala gap chhota, toh 1/12 sabse paas
whyShort.en: a gap out of 12 is shorter: 1/12

whyAlt.hi: ek pizza 4 logon mein baanto ya 12 mein: 12 wala hissa chhota hota hai; line par bhi 1/12 ka gap chhota, isliye woh 0 ke sabse paas
whyAlt.en: share a pizza among 4 or among 12: the share among 12 is smaller; on the line too the 1/12 gap is shorter, so it is nearest 0

answerViewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar 4 gaps mein hai, doosri 12 mein, aur dono ka pehla gap rangin hai. 1/12 wala rangin gap chhota hai, isliye woh 0 ke sabse paas hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The first row is in 4 gaps, the second in 12, and the first gap of each is coloured. The coloured 1/12 gap is shorter, so it is nearest 0.

simpler.hi: Bada number dekhkar mat chuno. Poori line ko jitne zyada barabar gaps mein kaato, har gap utna chhota hota hai.
simpler.en: Don't choose by the bigger number. The more equal gaps you cut the whole line into, the shorter each gap is.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 1 tak 9 barabar gaps mein hai. Kuch log sochte hain ki line par 1/9 ki koi jagah nahi hoti. 1/9 ki jagah 0 ke baad kaunsa mark hai?
prompt.en: The line from 0 to 1 is in 9 equal gaps. Some people think 1/9 has no place on a line. Which mark after 0 is the place of 1/9?

did.hi: 9 gaps wali line par 1/9 ki jagah dhoondhi
did.en: found where 1/9 sits on a line of 9 gaps

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, 0 se 1 tak ki line ab ek poori patti hai, nau barabar gaps mein kati hui. Patti ke 0 wale sire se gaps ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line from 0 to 1 is now one whole strip, cut into nine equal gaps. Look at the gaps one by one from the strip's 0 end.

why.hi: 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai
why.en: 1/9 means 1 gap out of 9 equal gaps, so 1/9 sits one gap from 0, at the first mark

whyShort.hi: 1/9 matlab 0 se ek gap, yaani pehla mark
whyShort.en: 1/9 is one gap from 0, the first mark

whyAlt.hi: jaise 7 gaps wali line par 1/7 ki ek pakki jagah thi, waise hi 9 gaps wali line par 1/9 ki bhi jagah hai; 1/9 matlab 9 mein se 1 gap
whyAlt.en: just as 1/7 had a fixed spot on the line with 7 gaps, 1/9 has a spot on the line with 9 gaps; 1/9 means 1 gap out of 9

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 9 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla gap rangin hai. Woh rangin gap jahan khatam hota hai, wahi line ka pehla mark hai, 1/9.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 9 equal gaps, and the first gap is coloured. Where that coloured gap ends is the line's first mark, 1/9.

simpler.hi: Socho, 1/9 kitne gaps ka naam hai, aur phir board par 0 se utne gaps gino.
simpler.en: Think how many gaps 1/9 is the name of, then count that many gaps from 0 on the board.

ladder.why: den 2: one cut, gaps obvious → fraction as a place on the road; same den as e1
den 4 (halves halved, as in the worked example) → 2nd mark = 2/4 → same spot as 1/2; gap-value thinking, not mark counting
den 5 given only as marks (4 inside) → must convert marks to gaps; error-spot on the count-marks trap
den 6 again but given as 5 inside marks → contrasts with rl-o1 (same den, gaps given) → explain why the label is wrong

remediation.move: ribbon at a tailor's shop, 0 to 1 m, the ribbon in 5 on the board; the cut in 12 is imagined (askWhole); marks = chalk marks, the ribbon between marks = gaps (never hisse); marks inside + 1 = gaps; a mark's name comes from counting gaps, not marks; 4 marks → 5 gaps → first mark at 1/5 m (not e2's 6 marks, 7 gaps); then imagined: first mark at 1/12 m → 12 gaps → 11 marks (the trap says 12)

say.hi: Darzi ka ribbon 0 se 1 metre tak hai, aur us par 4 chalk ke marks hain. Marks 4 hain, par gap 5 bante hain, isliye pehla mark 1/5 metre par hai.
say.en: The tailor's ribbon goes from 0 to 1 metre, and it has 4 chalk marks. There are 4 marks, but they make 5 gaps, so the first mark is at 1/5 metre.

simpler.hi: Ribbon par ungli 0 se 1 tak sarkao aur har gap par ek gino. Ginti chalk ke marks se ek zyada aati hai.
simpler.en: Slide your finger along the ribbon from 0 to 1 and count one for each gap. The count comes out one more than the chalk marks.

sayAlt.hi: Do deewaron ke beech kapde sukhane ki rassi par 4 clip socho: pehli deewar se pehle clip tak ek jagah, clipon ke beech 3, aur aakhri clip se deewar tak ek, kul 5. Chalk ke 4 marks bhi aise hi 5 gap banate hain.
sayAlt.en: Picture a clothesline between two walls with 4 pegs: one space from the first wall to the first peg, 3 between the pegs, and one from the last peg to the wall, 5 in all. The 4 chalk marks make 5 gaps the same way.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti darzi ka ribbon hai: paanch barabar gaps, aur pehla gap rangin, yaani 1/5 metre. Gaps ke beech ke marks hi chalk ke marks hain.
viewCaption.en: This strip is the tailor's ribbon: five equal gaps, and the first gap coloured, that is 1/5 metre. The marks between the gaps are the chalk marks.

prompt.hi: Socho, wahi ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaat rahe ho. Beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
prompt.en: Imagine cutting the same ribbon into 12 equal gaps. How many chalk marks go in between?

reask.hi: Socho, ek ribbon 12 barabar gaps mein kaatna hai: beech mein kitne chalk ke marks lagenge?
reask.en: Imagine a ribbon has to be cut into 12 equal gaps: how many chalk marks go in between?

viewCaption.hi: Yeh darzi ka ribbon hai: paanch barabar gaps, pehla gap 1/5 metre. Ise 12 barabar gaps mein kaatne ke marks tumhe sochne hain.
viewCaption.en: This is the tailor's ribbon: five equal gaps, the first gap 1/5 metre. You have to imagine the marks for cutting it into 12 equal gaps.

why.hi: 12 barabar gaps ke beech 11 marks hote hain, gaps se ek kam
why.en: 12 equal gaps have 11 marks between them, one fewer than the gaps

whyShort.hi: 12 gap ke beech 11 marks hote hain
whyShort.en: 12 gaps have 11 marks between them

whyAlt.hi: chhote numbers se socho: 2 gap ke beech 1 mark hota hai, 3 gap ke beech 2; har baar marks gap se ek kam, toh 12 gap ke beech 11 marks
whyAlt.en: think with small numbers: 2 gaps have 1 mark between them, 3 gaps have 2; marks are always one fewer than gaps, so 12 gaps have 11 marks

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar 12 barabar gaps mein hai. Uske gaps ke beech 11 kinaare hain, aur wahi 11 chalk ke marks hain.
answerViewCaption.en: The second row is in 12 equal gaps. There are 11 edges between its gaps, and those are the 11 chalk marks.

simpler.hi: Ribbon par gaps aur chalk ke marks dono gino, aur dekho kaun kitna zyada hai. Phir wahi baat naye ribbon ke liye socho.
simpler.en: Count both the gaps and the chalk marks on the ribbon, and work out which is more, and by how much. Then think the same for the new ribbon.

remediation.move: on a board of halves (first row) and fifths (second row), naming none of the then-card's numbers: both lines are the same whole; a bigger bottom number shares the same whole into more gaps, so each gap is smaller → bigger bottom number = smaller gap; then, on the then-card's board (fifths in the first row, sevenths in the second, 1/5 marked), the child places 1/7: between 0 and 1/5, not after it

say.hi: Ek taraf 2 barabar gap hain, doosri taraf 5. Gap jitne zyada, har gap utna chhota: 1/5 ka gap 1/2 wale se chhota.
say.en: On one side are 2 equal gaps, on the other 5. The more gaps, the smaller each gap: the 1/5 gap is smaller than the 1/2 one.

viewCaption.hi: Yahan ek hi line do qataron mein hai: pehli qatar do barabar gaps mein, doosri paanch mein, aur dono ka pehla gap rangin.
viewCaption.en: Here the one line is two rows: the first row in two equal gaps, the second in five, with the first gap of each coloured.

simpler.hi: Dono taraf ka pehla gap milao, aur dekho kaunsa chhota hai.
simpler.en: Compare the first gap on each side, and see which is shorter.

sayAlt.hi: Ek hi laddu socho: 2 bachchon mein baanto toh har ek ko bada hissa milta hai, 5 bachchon mein baanto toh chhota. Line par bhi aisa hi hai: 0 se 1 ko jitne zyada gaps mein baanto, har gap utna chhota.
sayAlt.en: Think of one laddu: share it between 2 children and each gets a big piece, between 5 and each gets a small one. The line is the same: the more gaps you cut 0 to 1 into, the smaller each gap.

prompt.hi: Ek taraf pehla mark 1/5 hai, doosri taraf 7 barabar gaps. 1/7 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/5 ke beech, ya 1/5 ke baad?
prompt.en: One side's first mark is 1/5; the other side has 7 equal gaps. Where does 1/7 go: between 0 and 1/5, or after 1/5?

viewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar ka pehla gap rangin hai, 1/5. Doosri qatar utni hi lambi hai par saat barabar gaps mein, uska pehla gap bhi baayein kinaare se dekho.
viewCaption.en: The first gap of the first row is coloured, 1/5. The second row is just as long but in seven equal gaps; look at its first gap from the left end too.

why.hi: 7 gaps wala har gap 5 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/7, 0 aur 1/5 ke beech rukta hai
why.en: a gap out of 7 is smaller than a gap out of 5, so 1/7 stops between 0 and 1/5

whyShort.hi: 1/7 ka gap chhota, toh woh 1/5 se pehle
whyShort.en: a 1/7 gap is smaller, so it stops before 1/5

whyAlt.hi: 5 gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte hain, aur 7 gap ko bhi wahi 0 se 1 bharna hai, toh 7 waala har gap 5 waale gap se chhota hoga
whyAlt.en: 5 gaps together fill 0 to 1, and 7 gaps must fill the same 0 to 1, so each of the 7 gaps will be shorter than a 5-gap

answerViewCaption.hi: Dono qataron ka pehla gap rangin hai. 1/7 wala rangin gap 1/5 wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/7, 0 aur 1/5 ke beech aata hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The first gap of both rows is coloured. The coloured 1/7 gap is shorter than the 1/5 one, so 1/7 comes between 0 and 1/5.

simpler.hi: 7 gaps wali taraf 0 se pehla gap dekho, aur dekho woh 1/5 wale mark se pehle khatam hota hai ya aage.
simpler.en: On the 7-gap side look at the first gap from 0, and see whether it ends before the 1/5 mark or beyond it.

remediation.move: road from home (0) to the chai stall (1 km), one line in 7 equal gaps on top; a toy walks from home and stops at the first mark → it stands on one real spot of the road → that spot has one number, 1/7 km; then the same road in 6 gaps below: the toy stops at the first mark below → that spot is one number too, 1/6 km (the trap says 1 and 6); no top number above 1 yet (taught in s2)

say.hi: Sadak 0 se 1 kilometre, 7 barabar gaps mein kati hai. Ek khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh ek pakki jagah hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre.
say.en: The road from 0 to 1 kilometre is cut into 7 equal gaps. A toy stopped at the first mark: that is a fixed spot, and its number is 1/7 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Ghar se khilone tak sadak ka bas ek gap hai, aur poori sadak mein aise 7 gap hain. Isliye khilona 7 mein se 1 gap par hai, yaani 1/7 kilometre.
simpler.en: From home to the toy is just one gap of the road, and the whole road has 7 such gaps. So the toy is 1 gap out of 7 along, that is 1/7 kilometre.

sayAlt.hi: Socho, ruler par 0 ke baad pehli lakeer ek pakki jagah hai, aur uska ek number hai. Sadak par khilona bhi ek pakki jagah ruka, isliye us jagah ka number 1/7 kilometre hai.
sayAlt.en: Think of a ruler: the first line after 0 is a fixed spot, and it has a number. The toy on the road also stopped at a fixed spot, so that spot's number is 1/7 kilometre.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh sadak hai, ghar se chai ki dukaan tak: saat barabar gaps, aur pehle mark tak 1/7 kilometre, jahan khilona ruka.
viewCaption.en: This is the road from home to the tea shop: seven equal gaps, and 1/7 kilometre to the first mark, where the toy stopped.

prompt.hi: Doosri taraf wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Khilona wahan pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?
prompt.en: The other side is the same road, 0 to 1, in 6 equal gaps. The toy stopped at its first mark: how many kilometres?

reask.hi: 1 kilometre ki sadak 6 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh pehle mark par ruka khilona 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
reask.en: If a 1-kilometre road is cut into 6 equal gaps, how many kilometres from 0 is a toy that stopped at the first mark?

viewCaption.hi: Dono qatarein ek hi sadak hain, ghar se chai ki dukaan tak. Pehli qatar mein pehla gap rangin hai, aur doosri chhe barabar gaps mein kati hai, abhi bina rang ke.
viewCaption.en: Both rows are the same road, from home to the chai stall. The first row has its first gap coloured, and the second is in six equal gaps, not coloured yet.

why.hi: doosri taraf sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre
why.en: on the other side the road has 6 equal gaps, and the first mark is one gap from 0: 1/6 kilometre

whyShort.hi: 6 barabar gaps, pehla mark ek gap par: 1/6 kilometre
whyShort.en: 6 equal gaps; the first mark is 1/6 kilometre

whyAlt.hi: khilona 6 barabar gaps wali sadak par 0 se bas ek gap chala; '6 mein se 1 gap' ko ek number mein bolte hain 1/6 kilometre
whyAlt.en: the toy walked just one gap from 0 on a road of 6 equal gaps; '1 gap out of 6' said as one number is 1/6 kilometre

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar wahi sadak hai, 6 barabar gaps mein, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai. Khilona us rangin gap ke ant par hai, 1/6 kilometre par.
answerViewCaption.en: The second row is the same road, in 6 equal gaps, and its first gap is coloured. The toy is at the end of that coloured gap, at 1/6 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Doosri taraf bhi wahi sadak hai, bas 6 barabar gaps mein. Ek gap poore kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, yahi socho.
simpler.en: The other side is the same road too, just in 6 equal gaps. Think which fraction of the whole kilometre one gap is.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne.
bridgeToNext.en: Next we'll move more than one gap from 0, and a fraction's top number will tell us how many.

simpler.hi: Ab 0 se do, teen, ya usse bhi zyada gap chalkar fraction dhoondhenge.
simpler.en: Next we'll find fractions by walking two, three or more gaps from 0.

covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki har fraction ki line par ek pakki jagah hoti hai, aur uska naam gaps ginkar milta hai.
covered.en: Today we saw that every fraction has a fixed place on the line, and its name comes from counting gaps.

hook.convey: same 0-to-1 stretch cut into equal stretches; the stop is not the first mark but several stretches on → its name needs two facts: how many equal stretches make the whole (bottom), how many are covered from 0 (top)

use.hi: Cricket pitch ko 4 barabar gaps mein baanto: batsman 0 wale stump se 3 gap paar karke ruka.
use.en: Split a cricket pitch into 4 equal gaps: the batsman ran from the stump at 0 and stopped after crossing 3 gaps.

use.hi: Game ki loading 0 se 1 tak, 5 barabar gaps mein bharti hai; abhi 2 gap bhari hai.
use.en: A game's loading fills from 0 to 1 in 5 equal gaps; right now 2 gaps are full.

explain.convey: thirds: bottom 3 → 0 to 1 in 3 equal gaps; top 2 → 2 hops of 1/3 from 0; landing mark = 2/3 → one point, one number, not 2 and 3 separately

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti teen barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle do gaps rangin hain, 2/3. Rang baayein kinaare se shuru hota hai, jaise line par 0 se gap chalna.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in three equal gaps, and the first two gaps are coloured, 2/3. The colour starts from the left end, like walking gaps from 0 on the line.

point.hi: Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number.
point.en: This time the line is cut into 3 equal gaps, each gap 1/3. Move 2 gaps from 0, one, two, and we're at 2/3. 2/3 is one place, one number.

pointAlt.hi: Chocolate se socho: 3 barabar hisson wali chocolate ke 2 hisse kha lo, toh tumne 2/3 chocolate khayi. Line par 1/3 wale 2 gap bhi waise hi 0 se 2/3 tak le jaate hain.
pointAlt.en: Think of a chocolate: eat 2 parts of a chocolate in 3 equal parts and you have eaten 2/3 of it. On the line, 2 gaps of 1/3 take you from 0 to 2/3 the same way.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
prompt.en: On the other side of the line there are 8 equal gaps. Move 5 gaps from 0. Which fraction do you reach?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line 8 barabar gaps mein kati ho, toh 0 se 5 gap chalkar kis fraction par pahunchoge?
reask.en: If the line from 0 to 1 is cut into 8 equal gaps, which fraction do you reach after 5 gaps from 0?

why.hi: har gap 1/8 ka, aur aise 5 gap mile toh 5/8
why.en: each gap is 1/8, and 5 of them make 5/8

whyShort.hi: 1/8 ke 5 gap, yaani 5/8
whyShort.en: 5 gaps of 1/8 make 5/8

whyAlt.hi: 8 barabar hisson wali chocolate mein se 5 hisse lo toh 8 mein se 5, yaani 5/8; line par bhi 8 mein se 5 gap
whyAlt.en: take 5 parts of a chocolate in 8 equal parts: 5 out of 8, that is 5/8; on the line it's 5 gaps out of 8

simpler.hi: 8 gaps wali taraf 0 se ek-ek gap chalo aur paanch tak gino. Phir dekho, poore 1 tak aise kitne gap hain.
simpler.en: On the 8-gap side walk one gap at a time from 0 and count to five. Then see how many such gaps there are up to the whole 1.

viewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar mein teen mein se do gaps rangin hain. Doosri qatar aath barabar gaps mein hai, bina rang ke, aur uske gaps bhi baayein kinaare se ek-ek karke gine jaate hain.
viewCaption.en: In the first row two of the three gaps are coloured. The second row is in eight equal gaps, not coloured, and its gaps are counted one by one from the left end too.

simpler.hi: 2/3 ko '3 mein se 2' padho: line jitne gaps mein kati, woh 3; tum jitne chale, woh 2.
simpler.en: Read 2/3 as '2 out of 3': the line is cut into 3, and you moved 2.

explain.convey: still thirds: 3 hops of 1/3 → every gap used → land exactly on 1 → 3/3 = 1; top < bottom → stop before 1; top = bottom → reach 1

viewCaption.hi: Is patti ke teeno barabar gaps rangin hain, toh poori patti bhar gayi. Koi gap khaali nahi bacha.
viewCaption.en: All three equal gaps of this strip are coloured, so the whole strip is filled. No gap is left empty.

point.hi: Line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 se teen gap chalo toh theek 1 aata hai, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1. Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain.
point.en: The line is cut into 3 equal gaps. Walk three gaps from 0 and you reach exactly 1, so there 3/3 = 1. The three gaps together fill the whole line from 0 to 1.

pointAlt.hi: Pizza ke 3 barabar hisse hon aur teeno le lo, toh poora pizza aa gaya: 3/3 ek poora hai. Line par bhi 3 mein se 3 gap chalkar hum poore 1 par hote hain.
pointAlt.en: If a pizza has 3 equal parts and you take all three, you have the whole pizza: 3/3 is one whole. On the line too, 3 gaps out of 3 put us on the whole 1.

prompt.hi: Ab socho, line 1/5 wale gaps mein kati hai. 0 se theek 1 tak aise kitne gap chalne honge?
prompt.en: Now imagine the line is cut into gaps of 1/5. How many such gaps do you move from 0 to reach exactly 1?

reask.hi: Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se theek 1 tak kitne gap chalne honge?
reask.en: If each gap is 1/5, how many gaps from 0 to exactly 1?

why.hi: 1/5 ke 5 gap milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1
why.en: 5 gaps of 1/5 make 5/5, and 5/5 = 1

whyShort.hi: 1/5 ke 5 gap se 5/5 = 1
whyShort.en: 5 gaps of 1/5 make 1

whyAlt.hi: ulta socho: 4 gap chalkar tum 1 se theek ek gap pehle ho; 1 par pahunchne ke liye ek gap aur, yaani kul paanch
whyAlt.en: think back from it: 4 gaps leave you exactly one gap short of 1; one more gap reaches 1, so five in all

simpler.hi: 1/3 wale teen gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte the. Ab socho, 1/5 jitne chhote gap poore 1 ko bharne ke liye kitne lagenge.
simpler.en: Three gaps of 1/3 together filled 0 to 1. Now think how many gaps as small as 1/5 it takes to fill the whole 1.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti teen barabar gaps mein hai, aur teeno gaps rangin hain: 0 se 1 tak poori bhari. 1/5 wale gaps abhi bane nahi, unhe tumhe sochna hai.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in three equal gaps, all three coloured: filled from 0 to 1. The gaps of 1/5 are not drawn yet; you have to imagine them.

pictureCaption.hi: Yeh 0 se 1 tak ki ek patti hai, teen barabar gaps mein, aur teeno rangin: 1/3 ke teen gap milkar poora 1 bharte hain. 1/5 wale gaps tumhe sochne hain.
pictureCaption.en: This is one strip from 0 to 1, in three equal gaps, all three coloured: three gaps of 1/3 together fill the whole 1. The gaps of 1/5 are for you to imagine.

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar ab paanch barabar gaps mein hai, aur paanchon rangin: 1/5 ke paanch gap milkar 0 se 1 bharte hain, 5/5 = 1.
answerViewCaption.en: The second row is now in five equal gaps, all five coloured: five gaps of 1/5 together fill 0 to 1, 5/5 = 1.

simpler.hi: 3 barabar gaps wali line par teeno gap chalo toh 1 aata hai. Ek bhi gap baaki nahi bachta, isliye chalna theek 1 par rukta hai.
simpler.en: On a line of 3 equal gaps, move all three and you reach 1. Not one gap is left over, so the walk stops exactly at 1.

explain.convey: each third cut in 2 → 6 equal gaps; the middle = half of the 6 gaps = 3 gaps → 3/6 = 1/2; fewer than half the gaps (2/6) → before the middle; more than half (5/6) → after the middle

viewCaption.hi: Teen ek jaisi pattiyaan hain, har ek chhe barabar gaps mein. Pehli mein do gaps rangin, doosri mein teen, aur teesri mein paanch, aur doosri ka rang theek aadhi patti tak hai.
viewCaption.en: There are three identical strips, each in six equal gaps. The first has two gaps coloured, the second three, and the third five, and the second one's colour reaches exactly half the strip.

point.hi: Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Theek beech ka mark 3/6 hai, aur 3, 6 ka aadha hai, toh 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 beech se pehle aata hai, 5/6 beech ke baad.
point.en: Now the line has 6 equal gaps. The mark right in the middle is 3/6, and 3 is half of 6, so 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 comes before the middle, 5/6 after it.

pointAlt.hi: Roti ke 6 barabar hisse socho: 3 hisse le lo toh theek aadhi roti hai, isliye 3/6 = 1/2 beech mein hai. 2 hisse aadhi se kam hain, toh 2/6 beech se pehle, aur 5 hisse aadhi se zyada, toh 5/6 beech ke baad.
pointAlt.en: Think of a roti in 6 equal parts: take 3 and you have exactly half, so 3/6 = 1/2 is the middle. 2 parts are less than half, so 2/6 comes before the middle, and 5 parts are more than half, so 5/6 after it.

prompt.hi: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?
prompt.en: On this same line, where does 4/6 go: before the middle, or after it?

reask.hi: Is line par 4/6 beech se pehle aayega, ya beech ke baad?
reask.en: On this line, does 4/6 come before the middle, or after it?

why.hi: beech 3/6 par hai, aur upar wala number 4 usse ek zyada hai, toh ek gap aage, beech ke baad
why.en: the middle is at 3/6, and a top number of 4 is one more, so one gap on, after the middle

whyShort.hi: beech 3/6 par, aur 4/6 usse ek gap aage
whyShort.en: the middle is 3/6, and 4/6 is one gap on

whyAlt.hi: 6 ka aadha 3 hai, aur 4 gap 3 gap se zyada hain
whyAlt.en: half of 6 is 3, and 4 gaps are more than 3 gaps

simpler.hi: Beech wale mark 3/6 se shuru karo. 4/6 tak pahunchne ke liye kis taraf ek gap chalna padega, woh dekho.
simpler.en: Start from the middle mark, 3/6. See which way you have to move one gap to reach 4/6.

simpler.hi: Beech wala mark 3/6 hai, teen gap par. 2/6 ke liye do gap chalo toh tum beech se pehle rukte ho, aur 5/6 ke liye paanch gap chalo toh beech ke aage nikal jaate ho.
simpler.en: The middle mark is 3/6, three gaps along. Move two gaps for 2/6 and you stop before the middle; move five for 5/6 and you go past it.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai.
problem.en: A number line goes from 0 to 1. We need to find the mark for 2/5 on it.

problemAlt.hi: Ek cheenti 0 se 2/5 tak jaana chahti hai. Use do baatein pata honi chahiye: ek gap kitna lamba hai, aur aise kitne gap chalne hain.
problemAlt.en: An ant wants to go from 0 to 2/5. It needs to know two things: how long one gap is, and how many such gaps to walk.

simpler.hi: Jaise pate ki do cheezein milkar ek hi ghar batati hain, waise hi 2/5 ke do number milkar line par ek jagah batate hain: ek number gap ka size batata hai, doosra kitne gap chalne hain.
simpler.en: Just as two parts of an address together name one house, the two numbers of 2/5 together name one spot on the line: one number sets the size of a gap, the other says how many gaps to move.

givens.hi: 2/5 mein neeche wala number 5, upar wala number 2
givens.en: 2/5 has bottom number 5 and top number 2

prompt.hi: 2/5 ke liye is line ka har gap kitne ka hoga?
prompt.en: For 2/5, what will each gap of this line be worth?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line par 2/5 dhoondhna hai: is line ka har barabar gap kitne ka hoga?
reask.en: We have to find 2/5 on the line from 0 to 1: what will each equal gap of this line be worth?

right.hi: Haan, 1/5: neeche wala 5 hai, toh line ke 5 barabar gaps.
right.en: Yes, 1/5: the bottom number is 5, so the line has 5 equal gaps.

why.hi: neeche wala number batata hai ki poora kitne barabar gaps mein kata hai
why.en: the bottom number says how many equal gaps the whole is cut into

told.hi: 2/5 ka neeche wala number 5 hai, toh 0 se 1 ki line 5 barabar gaps mein kategi, aur har gap 1/5 ka hai.
told.en: The bottom number of 2/5 is 5, so the line from 0 to 1 is cut into 5 equal gaps, and each gap is 1/5.

simpler.hi: 2/5 ke dono numbers mein se socho: kaunsa batata hai ki poora kitne gaps mein kata. Phir ek gap ka naam rakho.
simpler.en: Of the two numbers in 2/5, think which one says how many gaps the whole is cut into. Then name one gap.

steps.result: har gap ke ant par ek mark

why.hi: mark ka naam 0 se gine gaps se aata hai
why.en: a mark's name comes from the gaps counted from 0

told.hi: Ab 0 se 1/5 ka ek-ek gap chalte hain; har gap ke ant par ek mark aata hai.
told.en: Now we walk from 0 one gap of 1/5 at a time; at the end of each gap comes a mark.

simpler.hi: Ungli 0 par rakho aur ek gap aage badhao: wahan pehla mark hai.
simpler.en: Put a finger on 0 and move it one gap on: the first mark is there.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: 2/5 ke liye 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
prompt.en: Your turn: for 2/5, at which mark after 0 do you stop?

reask.hi: 2/5 dikhane ke liye, 5 gaps wali is line par 0 ke baad kaunse mark par rukoge?
reask.en: To show 2/5 on this line of 5 gaps, at which mark after 0 do you stop?

why.hi: upar wala number 2 kehta hai 1/5 ke do gap chalo, isliye hum doosre mark par rukte hain
why.en: the top number 2 says take two gaps of 1/5, so we stop at the second mark

whyAlt.hi: mark ka naam 0 se gine gaps se aata hai, aur ginti 0 ke baad wale mark se shuru hoti hai: 1/5 wala mark pehla, 2/5 wala doosra
whyAlt.en: a mark's name comes from the gaps counted from 0, and the count starts at the mark after 0: the 1/5 mark is the first, the 2/5 mark the second

simpler.hi: 2/5 ka upar wala number 2 hai. 0 se ek-ek gap karke chalo, aur gino.
simpler.en: The top number of 2/5 is 2. Step from 0 one gap at a time, and count.

why.hi: upar wala number 2 kehta hai 0 se 1/5 ke 2 gap chalo
why.en: the top number 2 says move 2 gaps of 1/5 from 0

viewCaption.hi: Yahan 0 se 1 tak ki line ek poori patti ban gayi hai, barabar gaps mein kati hui. Patti ke gaps 0 ki taraf se baari-baari dekho.
viewCaption.en: Here the line from 0 to 1 has become one whole strip, cut into equal gaps. Look at the strip's gaps in turn from the 0 side.

prompt.hi: Is line par 5 marks lage hain, aur saare gaps ek jitne hain. 0 ke baad chautha mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: This line has 5 marks on it, and all the gaps are the same. What fraction is the 4th mark after 0?

did.hi: 5 marks wali line par chauthe mark ka fraction nikala
did.en: named the 4th mark's fraction on a line of 5 marks

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti barabar gaps mein kati hai, aur baayein kinaare se kuch gaps rangin hain. Rang wahan khatam hota hai jahan line par chautha mark tha.
viewCaption.en: This strip is cut into equal gaps, and some gaps are coloured from the left end. The colour ends where the fourth mark was on the line.

why.hi: 5 marks se 6 barabar gaps bante hain, aur chautha mark 4 gaps par hai: 4/6, jo 2/3 ke barabar hai
why.en: 5 marks make 6 equal gaps, and the 4th mark is 4 gaps along: 4/6, which is the same as 2/3

whyShort.hi: 5 marks se 6 gaps; chautha mark 4 gaps par
whyShort.en: 5 marks, 6 gaps; the 4th mark is 4 gaps

whyAlt.hi: board par seedha gino: 0 se 1 tak 6 gaps hain aur 0 se chauthe mark tak 4 gaps, toh 6 mein se 4, yaani 4/6
whyAlt.en: count straight off the board: 0 to 1 has 6 gaps and 0 to the 4th mark has 4, so 4 out of 6, that is 4/6

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle chaar gaps rangin hain. Rang chauthe mark tak jaata hai, isliye woh mark 4/6 hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 6 equal gaps, and the first four gaps are coloured. The colour reaches the fourth mark, so that mark is 4/6.

simpler.hi: Pehle gaps gino, woh marks se ek zyada hote hain. Phir 0 se chaar gap chalo.
simpler.en: First count the gaps, one more than the marks. Then walk four gaps from 0.

prompt.hi: Line ki ek taraf har gap 1/5 ka hai, doosri taraf 1/10 ka. 1/10 ke kitne gap chalkar tum 3/5 tak pahunchoge?
prompt.en: On one side of the line each gap is 1/5, on the other 1/10. How many gaps of 1/10 do you move to reach 3/5?

reask.hi: Ek taraf 1/5 wale gaps hain, doosri taraf 1/10 wale; 0 se 3/5 tak pahunchne ke liye 1/10 ke kitne gap chalne honge?
reask.en: One side has gaps of 1/5, the other gaps of 1/10; how many gaps of 1/10 take you from 0 to 3/5?

did.hi: 3/5 tak ki doori 1/10 ke gaps mein naapi
did.en: measured the way to 3/5 in gaps of 1/10

viewCaption.hi: Do barabar lambi qatarein hain, pehli qatar paanch barabar gaps mein, doosri das mein. Pehli qatar ka har gap doosri qatar ke gaps ke saamne rakhkar dekho.
viewCaption.en: There are two rows of the same length, the first row in five equal gaps, the second in ten. Look at each gap of the first row against the gaps of the second.

why.hi: har 1/5 gap mein 1/10 ke do gap aate hain, toh 3/5 tak 1/10 ke 6 gap hain
why.en: each 1/5 gap holds two 1/10 gaps, so 3/5 is 6 gaps of 1/10

whyShort.hi: har 1/5 mein do 1/10, toh 6 gap
whyShort.en: two 1/10 in each 1/5: 6 gaps

whyAlt.hi: ek 10 rupaye ka note do 5 ke sikkon jitna hai; 3 note ke badle 6 sikke milte hain, waise hi 3 bade gaps ke badle 1/10 ke 6 chhote gap
whyAlt.en: one 10-rupee note is worth two 5-rupee coins; 3 notes change for 6 coins, and the same way 3 big gaps change for 6 small gaps of 1/10

answerViewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar mein 3/5 tak rang hai, doosri mein 6/10 tak, aur dono rang ek hi jagah rukte hain. Isliye 3/5 tak 1/10 ke 6 gap hain.
answerViewCaption.en: The first row is coloured up to 3/5, the second up to 6/10, and both colours stop at the same place. So 3/5 is 6 gaps of 1/10.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho, 1/5 ke ek gap mein 1/10 ke kitne gap samaate hain. Phir teen bade gaps ke liye socho.
simpler.en: First see how many gaps of 1/10 fit in one gap of 1/5. Then think it through for three big gaps.

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 3/4 do number hain, 3 aur 4. 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 dikhane ke liye tum kitne mark lagaoge?
prompt.en: {friend} says 3/4 is two numbers, 3 and 4. To show 3/4 on a 0-to-1 line, how many marks will you put?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ki line par 3/4 ki jagah dikhane ke liye kitne mark lagaoge?
reask.en: To show where 3/4 is on a 0-to-1 line, how many marks will you put?

did.hi: pehchaana ki 3/4 line par do nahi, ek hi jagah hai
did.en: saw that 3/4 is one place on the line, not two

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, 0 se 1 tak ki line ab ek poori patti hai, chaar barabar gaps mein. 3/4 ka upar wala aur neeche wala number is patti par kya batate hain, yeh socho.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line from 0 to 1 is now one whole strip in four equal gaps. Think what the top and the bottom number of 3/4 tell you on this strip.

why.hi: 3/4 akela ek number hai, toh line par uski sirf ek jagah hai: 0 se 3 gap chalkar, wahi ek mark
why.en: 3/4 is a single number, so it has just one place on the line: 3 gaps on from 0, that one mark

whyShort.hi: 3/4 ek number hai, toh line par ek mark
whyShort.en: 3/4 is one number, so one mark on the line

whyAlt.hi: jaise ghar ka ek hi pata hota hai, waise hi line par 3/4 ki ek hi jagah hai; 3 aur 4 milkar us ek jagah ka naam batate hain
whyAlt.en: just as a house has one address, 3/4 has one place on the line; the 3 and the 4 together name that one place

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 4 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle teen gaps rangin hain. Rang ek hi jagah rukta hai, aur wahi 3/4 ka ek mark hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 4 equal gaps, and the first three gaps are coloured. The colour stops at one place, and that is the one mark for 3/4.

simpler.hi: 3/4 ka neeche wala number 4 line ke barabar gaps banata hai, upar wala number 3 batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai. Ab line par chalo aur gino tum kitni jagah ruke.
simpler.en: The bottom number 4 of 3/4 makes the line's equal gaps, and the top number 3 says how many gaps to walk from 0. Now walk the line and count how many places you stopped.

ladder.why: den 4: quarters already known from s1 and the c4 roti → carry a shaded 3 of 4 onto the line; top = gaps moved
den 3: before or after the middle with thirds → 1/3 before, 2/3 after; carries e3's middle test (sixths) to a den whose middle is not a mark
den 5 reversed: given the mark, name the fraction → 4/5 km; read the line instead of marking it
den 10: each fifth split in 2 → many small gaps, unit given as 1/10 km → 7 steps = 7/10
den 8 against den 4 → two different cuts, same stopping point (6/8 = 3/4); closes the loop back to quarters

remediation.move: marks to gaps on one line, quarters on top: 3 marks inside → 4 gaps, since there is a gap before the first mark and after the last (gaps = marks + 1); each gap = 1/4; 0 is the start, not a gap; 2 gaps → 2/4; then below: 9 marks → 10 gaps → one gap is 1/10 (the trap says 1/9). Not c1's case (5 marks, sixths)

say.hi: 0 se pehle mark tak ek gap hai, doosre mark tak do gap. Hum gap ginte hain, mark nahi, isliye 3 marks wali line mein 4 gap hain.
say.en: From 0 to the first mark is one gap, to the second mark two gaps. We count gaps, not marks, so a line with 3 marks has 4 gaps.

simpler.hi: Marks ko kainchi ke kat socho: 3 kat lagao toh ribbon ke 4 hisse bante hain. Line par bhi 3 marks se 4 gap.
simpler.en: Think of the marks as scissor cuts: make 3 cuts and the ribbon is in 4 pieces. On the line too, 3 marks make 4 gaps.

sayAlt.hi: Chhota karke dekho: 0 aur 1 ke beech sirf 2 marks hon, toh gap 3 bante hain: 0 se pehle mark tak, phir doosre mark tak, phir 1 tak. Is line par bhi 3 marks ke 4 gap hain, isliye har gap 1/4.
sayAlt.en: Try it smaller: with just 2 marks between 0 and 1 there are 3 gaps: 0 to the first mark, then to the second, then to 1. On this line too, 3 marks give 4 gaps, so each gap is 1/4.

viewCaption.hi: Yeh patti chaar barabar gaps mein hai: line ke teen marks yahan gaps ke beech ke kinaare hain.
viewCaption.en: This strip is in four equal gaps: the line's three marks are the edges between the gaps here.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf dekho: wahan 9 marks lage hain, sab barabar doori par. Wahan ek gap kitne ka hai?
prompt.en: Look at the other side of the line: 9 marks are there, all equally spaced. How much is one gap there?

reask.hi: 0 se 1 ke beech 9 marks barabar doori par lage hon, toh ek gap kitne ka hai?
reask.en: If 9 equally spaced marks sit between 0 and 1, how much is one gap?

viewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar ke gaps ke beech ke marks hi line ki doosri taraf ke marks hain, aur pehli qatar mein chaar gaps hain, do rangin.
viewCaption.en: The marks between the second row's gaps are the marks on the other side of the line, and the first row has four gaps, two coloured.

why.hi: 9 marks se 10 barabar gaps bante hain, toh har gap 1/10
why.en: 9 marks make 10 equal gaps, so each gap is 1/10

whyShort.hi: 9 marks, 10 gaps: har gap 1/10
whyShort.en: 9 marks, 10 gaps: each is 1/10

whyAlt.hi: ek rassi ko 9 jagah kaato toh 10 barabar hisse bante hain, 9 nahi; line ke 9 marks bhi 10 gap banate hain, isliye ek gap 1/10 hai
whyAlt.en: cut a rope in 9 places and you get 10 equal pieces, not 9; the line's 9 marks make 10 gaps the same way, so one gap is 1/10

answerViewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar 10 barabar gaps mein hai, aur uska pehla gap rangin hai. Line ki doosri taraf ke 9 marks ne yahi 10 gaps banaye, toh har gap 1/10 hai.
answerViewCaption.en: The second row is in 10 equal gaps, and its first gap is coloured. The 9 marks on the other side of the line made these 10 gaps, so each gap is 1/10.

simpler.hi: Gap marks ke beech bhi hain aur dono siron par bhi. Pehle kul gap gino, phir socho ek gap kitne ka hai.
simpler.en: There are gaps between the marks and at both ends. First count all the gaps, then think what one gap is worth.

remediation.move: same number of hops, different hop size, on one 0-to-1 line, thirds on top, sixths below: a 1/3 hop is two 1/6 hops long; 2 hops of 1/6 stop at 2/6, 2 hops of 1/3 at 2/3 → bigger bottom number = shorter hops; then: 3 hops of 1/6 against 2/3

say.hi: Ek taraf har gap 1/3 hai, doosri taraf usse aadha, 1/6. 2 lambe gap 2/3 par rukte hain, 2 chhote 2/6 par.
say.en: On one side each gap is 1/3, on the other side half that, 1/6. 2 long gaps stop at 2/3, 2 short ones at 2/6.

simpler.hi: Dono taraf do-do gap hain. 1/3 wala gap bada, toh 2/3 aage, aur 1/6 wala chhota, toh 2/6 peeche.
simpler.en: Two gaps each side. The 1/3 gap is bigger, so 2/3 is further on, and the 1/6 gap is smaller, so 2/6 stays back.

sayAlt.hi: Ek glass mein 2 bade chammach cheeni daalo, doosre mein 2 chhote chammach: ginti dono mein 2, par bade chammach wale mein zyada cheeni. Line par bhi 1/3 ke 2 lambe gap, 1/6 ke 2 chhote gap se aage pahunchte hain.
sayAlt.en: Put 2 big spoons of sugar in one glass and 2 small spoons in another: the count is 2 in both, but the big-spoon glass has more sugar. On the line too, 2 long gaps of 1/3 reach further than 2 short gaps of 1/6.

viewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar ke do rangin gaps lambe hain, doosri qatar ke do rangin gaps chhote. Dono mein rangin gaps do-do hain, par rang kahan tak pahuncha, woh alag hai.
viewCaption.en: The first row's two coloured gaps are long, the second row's two coloured gaps short. Both have two coloured gaps, but how far the colour reaches is different.

prompt.hi: 1/3 ke 2 gap 2/3 tak gaye. Doosri taraf 1/6 ke 3 gap: woh 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya baad mein?
prompt.en: 2 gaps of 1/3 went to 2/3. On the other side, 3 gaps of 1/6: will they stop before 2/3, or after?

reask.hi: 1/6 ke 3 gap 0 se chalkar 2/3 se pehle rukenge, ya 2/3 ke baad?
reask.en: Do 3 gaps of 1/6 from 0 stop before 2/3, or after 2/3?

viewCaption.hi: Doosri qatar chhe barabar gaps mein hai, aur uske do chhote gaps rangin hain; pehli qatar mein teen mein se do lambe gaps rangin. Doosri qatar ke gaps baayein kinaare se ek-ek karke pehli qatar ke rang se milaao.
viewCaption.en: The second row is in six equal gaps, with two short gaps coloured; the first row has two of its three long gaps coloured. Set the second row's gaps, one by one from the left end, against the colour of the first.

why.hi: 1/6 ke 3 gap sirf beech tak jaate hain, aur 2/3 beech se aage hai
why.en: 3 gaps of 1/6 reach only the middle, and 2/3 is past the middle

whyShort.hi: 3 gap sirf beech tak; 2/3 beech se aage
whyShort.en: 3 gaps reach the middle; 2/3 is past it

whyAlt.hi: 2/3 tak pahunchne ke liye 1/6 ke 4 gap chahiye, kyunki har 1/3 mein do 1/6 hain; yahan gap sirf 3 hain
whyAlt.en: to reach 2/3 you need 4 gaps of 1/6, because each 1/3 holds two 1/6; here there are only 3 gaps

answerViewCaption.hi: Pehli qatar mein do lambe gaps rangin hain, doosri mein teen chhote. Doosri qatar ka rang pehli se pehle ruk jaata hai, isliye 3/6, 2/3 se pehle aata hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Two long gaps of the first row are coloured, three short ones of the second. The second row's colour stops before the first's, so 3/6 comes before 2/3.

simpler.hi: Do chhote 1/6 gap milkar ek lamba 1/3 gap banate hain. Ab socho, 2 lambe gap jitni doori ke liye kitne chhote gap chahiye.
simpler.en: Two short 1/6 gaps make one long 1/3 gap. Now think how many short gaps cover the distance of 2 long gaps.

remediation.move: on the then-card's own board (a 0-to-1 km line in eighths, the third stone marked), naming none of its numbers: each mark is a stone, one real spot of the road; wherever the toy stops it stands on one spot, so that spot has one number, a fraction, not two numbers; then the toy at the third stone → say it as one number, 3/8 km

say.hi: Line par har mark sadak ka ek patthar hai, ek pakki jagah. Khilona jis patthar par ruke, us jagah ka number ek hi hai: ek fraction.
say.en: Every mark on the line is a stone on a road, a fixed spot. Whichever stone the toy stops at, that spot has one number: a fraction.

simpler.hi: Khilone ki jagah ko do number mein bolo toh lagta hai do jagah hain, par board par mark ek hi hai. Ek mark, ek naam.
simpler.en: Say the toy's spot as two numbers and it sounds like two places, but the board has only one mark. One mark, one name.

sayAlt.hi: Aadha kilo aata socho, yaani 1/2 kilo: likhne mein 1 aur 2 dono dikhte hain, par woh ek hi wazan hai. Har fraction aisa hi hai: ek number, aur line par uski ek hi jagah.
sayAlt.en: Think of half a kilo of flour, that is 1/2 kilo: written, it shows a 1 and a 2, but it is one weight. Every fraction is like that: one number, with one place on the line.

viewCaption.hi: Is patti ko sadak samjho: gaps ke beech ka har kinaara ek patthar hai.
viewCaption.en: Take this strip as a road: every edge between the gaps is a stone.

prompt.hi: Har 1/8 kilometre par patthar hai. Khilona teesre patthar par hai: board par us jagah ko ek number mein kaise likhoge?
prompt.en: A stone every 1/8 kilometre. The toy stands at the third stone: how do you write that spot on the board as one number?

reask.hi: Har 1/8 kilometre par patthar ho, toh 0 ke baad teesra patthar ek number mein kitne kilometre par hai?
reask.en: With a stone every 1/8 kilometre, at how many kilometres is the third stone after 0, as one number?

viewCaption.hi: Yeh wahi sadak hai: rang 0 se shuru hokar ek mark par rukta hai. Poori patti ke gaps bhi dekho aur rangin gaps bhi.
viewCaption.en: This is the same road: the colour starts at 0 and stops at one mark. Look at all the strip's gaps, and at the coloured ones too.

why.hi: har patthar 1/8 kilometre aage hai, toh teesra patthar 3/8 kilometre par
why.en: each stone is 1/8 kilometre further on, so the third stone is at 3/8 kilometre

whyShort.hi: har patthar 1/8 aage, toh teesra 3/8 kilometre par
whyShort.en: each stone is 1/8 on; the third, 3/8 kilometre

whyAlt.hi: 3 aur 8 alag-alag bolo toh do jagah ban jaati hain, par khilona ek hi patthar par hai; 8 mein se 3 gap, ek number, 3/8 kilometre
whyAlt.en: say 3 and 8 apart and you get two places, but the toy is on one stone; 3 gaps out of 8, one number, 3/8 kilometre

answerViewCaption.hi: Patti 8 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehle teen gaps rangin hain. Rang teesre patthar par rukta hai, yaani 3/8 kilometre par.
answerViewCaption.en: The strip is in 8 equal gaps, and the first three gaps are coloured. The colour stops at the third stone, at 3/8 kilometre.

simpler.hi: Patthar se patthar 1/8 kilometre hai. Shuru se teesre patthar tak aise kitne gap hain, gino.
simpler.en: Stone to stone is 1/8 kilometre. Count how many of those gaps there are from the start to the third stone.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab fraction 1 ke aage bhi jaayenge: line kabhi 2 tak chalegi, kabhi 3 tak, aur dekhenge ki 1 se bade fraction kahan aate hain.
bridgeToNext.en: Next, fractions go past 1: the line will run to 2, sometimes to 3, and we'll see where fractions bigger than 1 sit.

simpler.hi: Ab hum 1 par nahi rukenge: 0 se itne gap chalenge ki 1 bhi peeche chhoot jaaye.
simpler.en: Now we won't stop at 1: we'll walk so many gaps from 0 that we leave 1 behind.

covered.hi: Phir upar wala number aaya, jo batata hai 0 se kitne gap chalna hai; dono milkar ek jagah batate hain.
covered.en: Then came the top number, which says how many gaps to go from 0; together the two name one place.

hook.convey: one whole is finished and the mover keeps going → the stopping point is past 1 → it needs a fraction name bigger than 1 → the line must go on beyond 1

use.hi: Cricket mein ek run matlab pitch ki poori lambai, 1; batsman doosre run ke beech ruka, 1 se aage.
use.en: In cricket one run is the pitch's whole length, 1; the batsman stopped partway through a second run, past 1.

use.hi: Train station 0 se chali, station 1 paar kiya, aur station 2 se pehle ruki: 1 ke aage.
use.en: A train left station 0, passed station 1 and stopped before station 2: past 1.

explain.convey: the line does not stop at 1 → it carries on to 2; the second whole is cut the same way → 4 equal gaps per whole, all the same size; 4 gaps from 0 = 4/4 = 1; the gap count from 0 keeps growing past 4

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab poori pattiyon mein hai, ek ke baad ek, aur har patti chaar barabar hisson mein. Pehli patti poori rangi hai, aur uske sire par 4/4 = 1 likha hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now whole strips, one after another, each in four equal parts. The first strip is coloured all the way, and at its end it reads 4/4 = 1.

point.hi: Yeh rahi 0 se 2 tak ki line. Har poore ke 4 barabar gaps hain, aur 1 wala mark hai 4/4, yaani 4/4 = 1. 1 ke aage bhi gaps usi size mein chalte rehte hain.
point.en: Here is a line from 0 to 2. Each whole has 4 equal gaps, and the mark at 1 is 4/4, so 4/4 = 1. Beyond 1 the gaps keep going, same size.

pointAlt.hi: Apna ruler dekho: woh 1 cm par khatam nahi hota, 2, 3, aage 15 cm tak chalta hai. Number line bhi waise hi 1 ke baad chalti rehti hai, aur wahan bhi har poore mein 4 barabar gaps hain.
pointAlt.en: Look at your ruler: it doesn't end at 1 cm, it goes on to 2, 3, all the way to 15 cm. The number line carries on after 1 the same way, and there too each whole has 4 equal gaps.

prompt.hi: 1/5 wale gaps ab doosri taraf hain. 0 se 6 gap chalo. 1 se pehle rukoge, ya 1 ke baad?
prompt.en: The 1/5 gaps are now on the other side. Move 6 gaps from 0. Will you stop before 1, or after 1?

reask.hi: Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se 6 gap chalkar 1 se pehle rukoge, ya 1 ke baad?
reask.en: If each gap is 1/5, after 6 gaps from 0 do you stop before 1, or after 1?

why.hi: 5 gap se 5/5 = 1 aa gaya, toh chhatha gap 1 ke baad, 6/5 par
why.en: 5 gaps already make 5/5 = 1, so the 6th gap lands after 1, at 6/5

whyShort.hi: 5 gap se 1 aa gaya, chhatha gap uske baad
whyShort.en: 5 gaps reach 1; the 6th gap is past it

whyAlt.hi: 5 barabar hisson wale ek pizza se 6 hisse nahi nikalte, doosra pizza kholna padta hai; waise hi 1/5 ke 6 gap ek poore se ek gap aage jaate hain
whyAlt.en: a pizza in 5 equal parts can't give 6 parts, you have to open a second one; just so, 6 gaps of 1/5 go one gap past a whole

simpler.hi: 1/5 wale gaps par 0 se gino, aur dekho ki 1 tak pahunchne mein kitne gap lagte hain.
simpler.en: Count along the gaps of 1/5 from 0, and see how many gaps it takes to reach 1.

viewCaption.hi: Ab pattiyon ki do qatarein hain: upar wali mein har patti chaar hisson mein, neeche wali mein paanch. Upar ki rangi patti dikhati hai ki 1 kahan hai; neeche ke hisse 0 se ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two rows of strips: in the top row each strip is in four parts, in the bottom row five. The coloured strip on top shows where 1 is; look at the bottom parts one by one from 0.

simpler.hi: 1 se 2 tak ki line bhi 0 se 1 jitni hi lambi hai, aur usmein bhi utne hi gap hain.
simpler.en: The stretch from 1 to 2 is just as long as 0 to 1, and it has just as many gaps.

explain.convey: 6 hops of 1/4 from 0: the first 4 hops fill one whole → reach 1; 2 more hops → past 1 → 6/4 = 1 and 2/4; top > bottom → beyond 1

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti chaar barabar hisson mein. 0 se 6/4 tak ke hisse rangin hain: pehli patti poori, aur agli ka thoda hissa.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now whole strips end to end, each in four equal parts. The parts from 0 up to 6/4 are coloured: the first strip in full, and some of the next.

point.hi: Line par har gap 1/4 hai. 0 se chhe gap chalo: pehle 4 gap 1 tak, phir do aur, aur hum 6/4 par.
point.en: Each gap on the line is 1/4. Walk six gaps from 0: the first 4 gaps to 1, then two more, and we are at 6/4.

pointAlt.hi: Ek jug mein 4 glass paani aata hai: 6 glass daalo toh ek jug bhar jaata hai aur 2 glass doosre jug mein jaate hain. 6/4 bhi aisa hi hai: ek poora, aur uske aage 2/4.
pointAlt.en: A jug holds 4 glasses of water: pour in 6 glasses and one jug fills, and 2 glasses go into a second jug. 6/4 is like that: one whole, and 2/4 past it.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf har gap 1/2 ka hai. 0 se aise 4 gap chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?
prompt.en: On the other side of the line each gap is 1/2. Moving 4 such gaps from 0, which number on the line do you reach?

reask.hi: 1/2 wale 4 gap 0 se chalkar line ke kis number tak pahunchoge?
reask.en: Moving 4 gaps of 1/2 from 0, which number on the line do you reach?

why.hi: 4/2 matlab 1/2 ke 4 gap, aur har 2 gap se ek poora banta hai, toh 4/2 = 2
why.en: 4/2 is 4 gaps of 1/2, and every 2 gaps make one whole, so 4/2 = 2

whyShort.hi: do gap ek poora hain, toh 4 gap 2 poore
whyShort.en: two gaps make a whole, so 4 gaps are 2

whyAlt.hi: 2 aadhi rotiyan milkar ek poori roti; 4 aadhi rotiyan, toh 2 poori rotiyan, isliye 4/2 = 2
whyAlt.en: 2 half rotis make one whole roti; 4 halves make 2 whole rotis, so 4/2 = 2

simpler.hi: Do aadhe milkar ek poora banate hain. 1/2 wale gaps ko do-do karke gino.
simpler.en: Two halves make one whole. Count the gaps of 1/2 in twos.

viewCaption.hi: Ab pattiyon ki do qatarein hain: upar wali mein 6/4 tak rang bhara hai, aur neeche wali ki har patti sirf do bade hisson mein kati hai. Neeche ke hisse 0 se ek-ek karke dekho.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two rows of strips: the top row is coloured up to 6/4, and each strip of the bottom row is cut into just two big parts. Look at the bottom parts one by one from 0.

simpler.hi: Chaar chauthai milkar ek poora banta hai. Chhe chauthai mein ek poora bhi hai, aur do chauthai usse aage.
simpler.en: Four quarters make one whole. Six quarters hold one whole, and two quarters more beyond it.

explain.convey: thirds on a line to 3: every 3 gaps = one whole → 3/3 = 1; group the gaps in threes to find which wholes a fraction has passed; top above 3 → past 1

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab teen poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti teen barabar hisson mein. Pehli patti rangi hai aur uske sire par 3/3 = 1 likha hai: har patti ek poora hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now three whole strips end to end, each in three equal parts. The first strip is coloured and at its end it reads 3/3 = 1: each strip is one whole.

point.hi: Yeh line 0 se 3 tak hai, har poore ke 3 barabar gaps. Teen gaps chalo toh 1 aata hai, 3/3 = 1. Teen-teen gaps ka har group ek poora hai.
point.en: This line runs from 0 to 3, each whole in 3 equal gaps. Walk three gaps and you reach 1, 3/3 = 1. Each group of three gaps is one whole.

pointAlt.hi: Laddu ginte waqt hum unhe teen-teen ke group mein rakhte hain. Is line ke gaps bhi waise hi gino: har 3 gaps ka group ek poora hai, isliye pehle group ke end par 1 hai.
pointAlt.en: When counting laddoos we put them in groups of three. Count this line's gaps the same way: each group of 3 gaps is one whole, so 1 is at the end of the first group.

prompt.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakho. Har group mein theek teen gap hon, toh kitne group bante hain?
prompt.en: Put the 7 gaps of 7/3 in threes. If each group has exactly three gaps, how many groups do you get?

reask.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps mein theek teen-teen gaps wale kitne group bante hain?
reask.en: How many groups of exactly three gaps are in the 7 gaps of 7/3?

why.hi: 7/3 ke 7 gaps mein teen-teen gaps ke 2 group bante hain, 6/3 = 2, aur 1 gap bachta hai
why.en: 7/3 has 7 gaps: 2 groups of three gaps, 6/3 = 2, and 1 gap left over

whyShort.hi: teen-teen ke 2 group, aur 1 gap bachta hai
whyShort.en: 2 groups of three, and 1 gap left over

whyAlt.hi: 7 laddu teen-teen karke rakho: 3, phir 3, aur 1 bacha; teen wale 2 group, isliye 7/3, 2 ke aage hai
whyAlt.en: set 7 laddoos out in threes: 3, then 3, and 1 left; 2 groups of three, so 7/3 is past 2

simpler.hi: Saat gaps ko teen-teen ke group mein rakhte jao. Jo gap akela bach jaaye, woh group nahi banata.
simpler.en: Keep putting the seven gaps into groups of three. A gap left on its own does not make a group.

simpler.hi: Teen gap chalo toh 1 aata hai, teen aur chalo toh agla poora number. Har poora number pichhle se teen gap aage hai.
simpler.en: Move three gaps and you reach 1; three more and you reach the next whole number. Each whole number is three gaps past the one before.

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 2 tak hai, barabar gaps mein kati hui. Is par 7/4 ka mark dhoondhna hai.
problem.en: A number line goes from 0 to 2, cut into equal gaps. We need to find the mark for 7/4 on it.

problemAlt.hi: 7/4 mein upar wala number 7 neeche wale 4 se bada hai, isliye yeh mark 1 ke aage milega. Hum pehle 1 tak pahunchenge, phir uske aage gap ginenge.
problemAlt.en: In 7/4 the top number 7 is bigger than the bottom 4, so this mark is past 1. We first get to 1, then count gaps beyond it.

simpler.hi: Roti se socho: 7/4 matlab ek jaise 7 hisse. Pehle dekhenge ki kitne hisson se ek poori roti banti hai, phir bache hue hisse.
simpler.en: Think of roti: 7/4 means 7 same-size pieces. First we'll see how many pieces make one whole roti, then the pieces left over.

givens.hi: 7/4 mein neeche wala number 4, upar wala number 7
givens.en: 7/4 has bottom number 4 and top number 7

prompt.hi: 7/4 ke 7 gaps mein se kitne gap chalkar hum theek 1 par pahunchenge?
prompt.en: Of the 7 gaps of 7/4, after how many are we exactly at 1?

reask.hi: 0 se 2 ki line par 7/4 ke liye 7 gap chalne hain: unme se kitne gap chalkar tum theek 1 par pahunchoge?
reask.en: On the line from 0 to 2, 7/4 means walking 7 gaps: after how many of them are you exactly at 1?

right.hi: Haan, 4 gap: har poore mein 4 gap hain, toh 4/4 = 1.
right.en: Yes, 4 gaps: each whole has 4 gaps, so 4/4 = 1.

do.en: First count the gaps up to 1

why.hi: neeche wala number 4 batata hai ki ek poore mein 4 gap hain
why.en: the bottom number 4 says one whole has 4 gaps

told.hi: Pehle 1 tak chalte hain: 7/4 ka neeche wala number 4 hai, toh ek poore mein 4 gap hain, aur 4 gap chalkar hum 1 par hain.
told.en: First we walk to 1: the bottom number of 7/4 is 4, so one whole has 4 gaps, and after 4 gaps we are at 1.

simpler.hi: 7/4 ka neeche wala number dekho: woh batata hai ki ek poore mein kitne gap hain.
simpler.en: Look at the bottom number of 7/4: it tells how many gaps make one whole.

do.hi: Ab 1 ke aage baaki gap chalo
do.en: Now walk the remaining gaps past 1

why.hi: 7/4 ke saare 7 gap 0 se gine jaate hain
why.en: all 7 gaps of 7/4 are counted from 0

told.hi: Ab 1 ke aage chalte hain, kyunki 7/4 ke saare 7 gap 0 se gine jaate hain.
told.en: Now we go on past 1, because all 7 gaps of 7/4 are counted from 0.

simpler.hi: 1 par ruk mat jao: 7 gap poore hone tak aage chalna hai.
simpler.en: Don't stop at 1: keep going until all 7 gaps are walked.

prompt.hi: Tumhari baari: 1 ke baad kaunse mark par 7/4 aayega?
prompt.en: Your turn: at which mark after 1 does 7/4 come?

reask.hi: Har gap 1/4 ka hai; 1 ke baad kaunse mark par 7/4 aayega?
reask.en: Each gap is 1/4; at which mark after 1 does 7/4 come?

why.hi: 7/4 ke liye 7 gap chahiye, aur 1 tak 4 ho chuke, toh 1 ke baad 3 gap aur: teesra mark
why.en: 7/4 needs 7 gaps, and 4 took us to 1, so 3 more gaps after 1: the third mark

whyAlt.hi: 1 ke baad ek-ek gap gino aur 7/4 par ruko: ek, do, teen; yaani teen gap aur
whyAlt.en: count gaps one at a time after 1 and stop at 7/4: one, two, three; that is three more gaps

simpler.hi: 1 tak 4 gap ho chuke. Ab 1 ke aage ek-ek gap gino, jab tak kul ginti 7 na ho jaaye.
simpler.en: 4 gaps are done by 1. Now count gaps one by one past 1, until the total count reaches 7.

answer.hi: 7/4, 1 ke baad teesra mark hai, yaani 1 aur 3/4, 2 se bas ek gap pehle
answer.en: 7/4 is the 3rd mark after 1, that is 1 and 3/4, just one gap before 2

why.hi: 1 ke baad 3 gap aur chalne the
why.en: after 1 there were 3 more gaps to walk

viewCaption.hi: Yahan 0 se 2 tak ki line poori pattiyon mein hai, ek ke baad ek, har patti barabar hisson mein. Har patti ka sira ek poora number hai, aur 7/4 ki jagah inhi hisson mein dhoondhni hai.
viewCaption.en: Here the line from 0 to 2 is whole strips end to end, each strip in equal parts. The end of each strip is a whole number, and the place of 7/4 is to be found among these parts.

prompt.hi: Ek line lo, 0 se 2 tak, har poora 3 barabar gaps mein. 5/3 kaun se do numbers ke beech aata hai: 0 aur 1, ya 1 aur 2?
prompt.en: Take a line from 0 to 2, each whole in 3 equal gaps. Between which two numbers is 5/3: 0 and 1, or 1 and 2?

did.hi: teen-teen gaps ke group banakar 5/3 ki jagah dhoondhi
did.en: grouped the gaps in threes to find where 5/3 sits

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti teen barabar hisson mein. 0 se hisse gino: har patti ke sire par ek poora number aata hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now whole strips end to end, each in three equal parts. Count the parts from 0: at the end of each strip comes a whole number.

why.hi: 3/3 = 1 aur 6/3 = 2, aur 5/3 dono ke beech hai
why.en: 3/3 = 1 and 6/3 = 2, and 5/3 sits between them

whyShort.hi: 5/3, 3/3 aur 6/3 ke beech hai
whyShort.en: 5/3 sits between 3/3 and 6/3

whyAlt.hi: 5/3 ke 5 gap mein se pehle 3 gap 1 tak le jaate hain, aur bache 2 gap ek aur poora nahi banate, toh woh 1 aur 2 ke beech rukta hai
whyAlt.en: of 5/3's 5 gaps, the first 3 take you to 1, and the 2 left don't make another whole, so it stops between 1 and 2

answerViewCaption.hi: Yahan 0 se 5/3 tak ke hisse rangin hain: pehli patti poori, yaani 1, aur agli patti ke do hisse. Isliye 5/3, 1 aur 2 ke beech hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Here the parts from 0 to 5/3 are coloured: the first strip in full, that is 1, and two parts of the next strip. So 5/3 is between 1 and 2.

simpler.hi: Line par 1 aur 2 ke mark dekho, aur gino ki 0 se har ek tak kitne gap hain. Phir 5/3 ke gap gino.
simpler.en: Look at the marks for 1 and 2 on the line, and count how many gaps there are from 0 to each. Then count the gaps of 5/3.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 2 tak. 1/6 ke 11 gap chalo, ya 1/12 ke 11 gap. 0 se zyada door kaun gaya: 11/6 ya 11/12?
prompt.en: A line from 0 to 2. Move 11 gaps of 1/6, or 11 gaps of 1/12. Which goes further from 0: 11/6 or 11/12?

hindi.hi: Do bachche 0 se 2 tak ki line par chale, aur dono ne 11 gap chale: ek ka har gap 1/6 ka, doosre ka 1/12 ka. 11/6 aur 11/12 mein se kaun aage nikla?
hindi.en: Two children walked a line from 0 to 2, and both walked 11 gaps: one child's every gap was 1/6, the other's 1/12. Of 11/6 and 11/12, which got further?

did.hi: 1/6 aur 1/12 ke 11-11 gap chalkar dekha kaun aage gaya
did.en: walked 11 gaps of 1/6 and of 1/12 to compare them

viewCaption.hi: Ab pattiyon ki do qatarein hain, dono 0 se shuru: upar ki har patti chhe hisson mein, neeche ki barah chhote hisson mein. Dono qatar mein patti ki lambai ek jaisi hai.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two rows of strips, both starting at 0: each strip on top is in six parts, each below in twelve smaller parts. The strips are the same length in both rows.

why.hi: 1/6 ka gap 1/12 wale se do guna hai, toh 11/6, yaani 1 aur 5/6, 11/12 se aage hai
why.en: a 1/6 gap is twice a 1/12 one, so 11/6, that is 1 and 5/6, is past 11/12

whyShort.hi: 1/6 ka gap do guna, toh 11/6 aage
whyShort.en: a 1/6 gap is twice as long; 11/6 is further

whyAlt.hi: 11/12 mein upar wala number 11 neeche wale number 12 se chhota hai, toh woh 1 se pehle; 11/6 mein upar wala number 11 neeche wale number 6 se bada hai, toh woh 1 ke aage, isliye 11/6 door hai
whyAlt.en: in 11/12 the top number 11 is smaller than the bottom number 12, so it's before 1; in 11/6 the top number 11 is bigger than the bottom number 6, so it's past 1, which makes 11/6 further

answerViewCaption.hi: Upar 11/6 tak rang pehli patti ke paar, agli patti mein jaata hai; neeche 11/12 tak rang pehli patti mein hi ruk jaata hai. Isliye 11/6 zyada door hai.
answerViewCaption.en: On top the colour up to 11/6 goes past the first strip into the next; below, the colour up to 11/12 stops inside the first strip. So 11/6 is further.

simpler.hi: Gap dono taraf 11 hain. Lamba gap kaunsa hai, 1/6 wala ya 1/12 wala, bas yeh socho.
simpler.en: 11 gaps on each side. Just think which gap is longer, the 1/6 one or the 1/12 one.

prompt.hi: Is line par 0, 1, 2 aur 3 likhe hain, aur har do poore numbers ke beech 5 barabar gaps hain. 2 ke baad doosra mark kaunsa fraction hai?
prompt.en: This line has 0, 1, 2 and 3 written on it, with 5 equal gaps between each pair of whole numbers. What fraction is the 2nd mark after 2?

did.hi: 0 se gaps ginkar 2 ke baad doosre mark ka naam rakha
did.en: counted the gaps from 0 and named the second mark after 2

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab teen poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti paanch barabar hisson mein. Sawaal wale mark tak ke hisse rangin hain; 0 se rangin hisse gino.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now three whole strips end to end, each in five equal parts. The parts up to the question mark are coloured; count the coloured parts from 0.

why.hi: har 5 gaps se ek poora, toh 2 tak 10 gaps; 2 aur chalo toh 12/5, yaani 2 aur 2/5
why.en: every 5 gaps make one whole, so 2 is 10 gaps; 2 more make 12/5, that is 2 and 2/5

whyShort.hi: 2 tak 10 gaps, aur 2 gap aage: 12/5
whyShort.en: 10 gaps reach 2, and 2 more make 12/5

whyAlt.hi: 12 gaps ko paanch-paanch karke gino: 5, phir 5, aur 2 bache; yaani 2 poore aur 2 gap, jo 2 ke baad doosra mark hai, isliye 12/5
whyAlt.en: count 12 gaps in fives: 5, then 5, and 2 left; that is 2 wholes and 2 gaps, the 2nd mark after 2, so 12/5

answerViewCaption.hi: Do poori pattiyan rangi hain, yaani 10 hisse, aur teesri patti ke 2 hisse aur. 0 se kul 12 hisse, har ek 1/5 ka, isliye 12/5.
answerViewCaption.en: Two whole strips are coloured, that is 10 parts, and 2 more parts of the third strip. 12 parts from 0 in all, each 1/5, so 12/5.

simpler.hi: Pehle gino 0 se 2 tak kitne gaps hain, phir usme 2 aur jodo. Wahi kul ginti fraction ka upar wala number hai.
simpler.en: First count the gaps from 0 to 2, then add 2 more. That total is the fraction's top number.

ladder.why: den 4 on 0 to 2, same den and line as e1, e2 and the worked example → 5/4 = one quarter past 1; smallest step beyond 1
den 3, no line given → decide before/after 1 from top vs bottom alone (4 > 3); moves the rule off the picture
den 2 inside a story: 1 km + half km → count in halves → 3/2; build the improper fraction from a real distance

remediation.move: eighth-gaps laid end to end on a 0-to-2 line, no squeezing: 8 gaps fill 0 to 1 exactly → 1 is full → the 9th gap must go past 1; then below, each whole in sixths: a runner runs 7 gaps → 7/6; a fraction is a length, and lengths can exceed one whole

say.hi: Yeh line 0 se 2 tak hai, har gap 1/8. 8 gap chalkar 1 aata hai, yaani 8/8; naunva gap 1 ke aage hai.
say.en: This line goes from 0 to 2, each gap 1/8. Walking 8 gaps brings us to 1, that is 8/8; the ninth gap is past 1.

simpler.hi: Ek bench par aath bachchon ki jagah ho aur nau bachche aayein, toh naunve ko doosri bench par baithna padta hai. Naunva gap bhi aise hi 1 ke aage jaata hai.
simpler.en: If a bench has room for eight children and nine come, the ninth has to sit on a second bench. The ninth gap goes past 1 the same way.

sayAlt.hi: 1 se peeche ki taraf dekho: 1 par 8/8 hai, aur usse ek gap peeche 7/8. Ginti 8 se jitni aage badhti hai, gap utne hi 1 ke paar jaate hain, jaise naunva gap 9/8 par.
sayAlt.en: Look back from 1: 8/8 is at 1, and one gap back is 7/8. However far the count goes past 8, that many gaps go past 1, like the ninth gap at 9/8.

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab do poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti aath barabar hisson mein. Pehli patti poori rangi hai aur uske sire par 8/8 = 1 likha hai; agla hissa doosri patti mein hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now two whole strips end to end, each in eight equal parts. The first strip is coloured in full and its end reads 8/8 = 1; the next part is in the second strip.

prompt.hi: Line ki doosri taraf har poora, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein hai. Runner 0 se 7 gap daudta hai: kis fraction par ruka?
prompt.en: On the other side each whole, 0 to 1, is in 6 equal gaps. A runner runs 7 gaps from 0: at which fraction did they stop?

reask.hi: Har poora 6 barabar gaps mein ho, toh 0 se 7 gap daudkar runner kis fraction par rukta hai?
reask.en: If each whole is in 6 equal gaps, what fraction does a runner stop on after 7 gaps from 0?

viewCaption.hi: Ab pattiyon ki do qatarein hain: upar ki pehli patti 8/8 tak poori rangi hai, aur neeche ki har patti chhe barabar hisson mein. Neeche ke hisse 0 se gino, aur dekho pehli patti kahan khatam hoti hai.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two rows of strips: the first strip on top is coloured in full, up to 8/8, and each strip below is in six equal parts. Count the bottom parts from 0, and see where the first strip ends.

why.hi: har gap 1/6 hai, aur runner ne 7 gap daude, toh 7/6, yaani 1 aur 1/6
why.en: each gap is 1/6 and the runner ran 7 gaps, so 7/6, that is 1 and 1/6

whyShort.hi: 1/6 ke 7 gap, yaani 7/6
whyShort.en: 7 gaps of 1/6 make 7/6

whyAlt.hi: 6/6 par runner 1 tak pahunch gaya, par ruka nahi, ek gap aur daudha; isliye woh 1 ke aage, 7/6 par hai
whyAlt.en: at 6/6 the runner reached 1 but didn't stop, running one more gap; so the runner is past 1, at 7/6

answerViewCaption.hi: Neeche 7/6 tak rang pehli patti poori bharta hai, aur agli patti ka ek hissa. Pehli patti 1 hai, isliye 7/6, 1 ke thoda aage hai.
answerViewCaption.en: Below, the colour up to 7/6 fills the first strip and one part of the next. The first strip is 1, so 7/6 is just past 1.

simpler.hi: Runner wali taraf ek gap poore ka kitna hai, yeh socho, phir dekho usne aise kitne gap daude.
simpler.en: On the runner's side think how much of a whole one gap is, then see how many such gaps they ran.

remediation.move: on the then-card's own board (a 0-to-2 line, fifths on top, tenths below), naming none of its numbers: same top number → same gap count; a bigger bottom number → shorter gaps → the same number of gaps stops sooner; then the child says which of 9/5 and 9/10 is past 1

say.hi: Socho, do fractions ka upar wala number ek jaisa hai, toh dono mein utne hi gap chalne hain. Jiska neeche wala number bada hai, uska har gap chhota hai, toh woh kam door jaata hai.
say.en: Picture two fractions with the same top number: both walk the same number of gaps. The one with the bigger bottom number has shorter gaps, so it goes less far.

simpler.hi: Dono mein gap ki ginti ek hai. Bas socho, jis taraf ek poore mein kam gaps hain, wahan ek gap lamba hota hai.
simpler.en: The gap count is the same. Just think: on the side with fewer gaps in one whole, each gap is longer.

sayAlt.hi: Do trainon mein 3-3 dibbe hain, ek ke dibbe lambe, ek ke chhote: ginti barabar, par lambe dibbon wali train zyada lambi hai. Fraction mein bhi upar wala number ek ho, toh jiska neeche wala number chhota, uske gap lambe, aur woh aage pahunchta hai.
sayAlt.en: Two trains have 3 coaches each, one with long coaches, one with short: the count is the same, but the long-coach train is longer. With fractions too, when the top numbers match, the one with the smaller bottom number has longer gaps and reaches further.

prompt.hi: Nayi line 0 se 2 tak hai: ek taraf har poora 5 gaps mein, doosri taraf 10 mein. Kaun 1 ke aage hai: 9/5 ya 9/10?
prompt.en: A new line from 0 to 2: on one side each whole is in 5 gaps, on the other in 10. Which is past 1: 9/5 or 9/10?

viewCaption.hi: Ab pattiyon ki do qatarein hain, dono 0 se shuru: upar ki har patti paanch hisson mein, neeche ki das chhote hisson mein. Pehli patti ka sira 1 hai, dono qatar mein ek hi jagah.
viewCaption.en: Now there are two rows of strips, both starting at 0: each strip on top is in five parts, each below in ten smaller parts. The end of the first strip is 1, at the same place in both rows.

why.hi: dono mein 9 gap, par 1/5 wala gap do guna lamba: 9/5, yaani 1 aur 4/5, aur 9/10, 1 se pehle
why.en: both are 9 gaps, but a 1/5 gap is twice a 1/10: 9/5, that is 1 and 4/5; 9/10 is before 1

whyShort.hi: 1/5 wala gap do guna lamba, toh 9/5 aage
whyShort.en: a 1/5 gap is twice as long; 9/5 is further

whyAlt.hi: 9/10 toh 1 tak bhi nahi pahunchta, par 9/5 mein pehle 5 gap se hi 1 aa jaata hai aur 4 gap aur bachte hain
whyAlt.en: 9/10 never even reaches 1, but in 9/5 the first 5 gaps already reach 1 and 4 more are left

answerViewCaption.hi: Upar 9/5 tak rang pehli patti ke paar jaata hai, neeche 9/10 tak rang pehli patti ke andar ruk jaata hai. Isliye 9/5, 1 ke aage hai.
answerViewCaption.en: On top the colour up to 9/5 goes past the first strip; below, the colour up to 9/10 stops inside the first strip. So 9/5 is past 1.

simpler.hi: Line par 1 wala mark dekho, aur gino ki dono taraf 1 tak kitne gap hain. Phir socho, dono fraction mein se kaun 1 ko paar karta hai.
simpler.en: Look at the mark for 1 on the line, and count how many gaps each side has up to 1. Then think which of the two fractions passes 1.

remediation.move: train between stations, on the then-card's own board (stations 0, 1, 2, each stretch in 5 equal parts): station 1 = 5/5; wherever the train halts is one real spot on the track with one number: the parts counted from 0, over 5; then a train from station 1 that goes 3 parts on

say.hi: Yeh stations 0 se 2 tak hain, aur har do stations ke beech 5 barabar gaps hain; station 1 par 5/5 hai. Train jahan rukti hai, uska number ek fraction hai: upar wala number 0 se gine gaps, aur neeche wala number 5.
say.en: These stations go from 0 to 2, with 5 equal gaps between each two stations; station 1 is at 5/5. Where the train stops, its number is one fraction: the top number is the gaps counted from 0, and the bottom number is 5.

simpler.hi: Station 1 ke aage bhi gap 0 se hi gine jaate hain, ginti 1 par rukti nahi. Isliye 1 ke baad wale mark ka upar wala number 5 se bada hota hai.
simpler.en: Past station 1 the gaps are still counted from 0; the count does not stop at 1. So a mark after 1 has a top number bigger than 5.

sayAlt.hi: Chhoti line socho, 0 se 1, sirf 2 barabar gaps: beech ka mark ek hi jagah hai, aur uska naam ek hi number hai, 1/2. Stations ki line par bhi train jahan ruke, uska naam ek fraction hai, do alag number nahi.
sayAlt.en: Picture a small line, 0 to 1, with just 2 equal gaps: the middle mark is one place, and its name is one number, 1/2. On the line of stations too, wherever the train stops, its name is one fraction, not two separate numbers.

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, stations ki line ab do poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, har patti paanch barabar hisson mein. Pehli patti rangi hai aur uske sire par 5/5 = 1 likha hai: wahi station 1 hai.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line of stations is now two whole strips end to end, each in five equal parts. The first strip is coloured and its end reads 5/5 = 1: that is station 1.

prompt.hi: Isi 0 se 2 ki line par ek doosri train station 1 se chali aur 3 gap aage ruki. Woh kis fraction par khadi hai?
prompt.en: On this line from 0 to 2, another train starts at station 1 and stops 3 gaps on. What fraction is it standing on?

reask.hi: Har do stations ke beech 5 barabar gaps hon, toh station 1 se 3 gap aage ruki train kis fraction par khadi hai?
reask.en: If there are 5 equal gaps between each two stations, at which fraction is a train that stopped 3 gaps past station 1?

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, line ab do poori pattiyan hain, har patti paanch barabar hisson mein. Sawaal wale mark tak ke hisse rangin hain: pehli patti poori, aur station 1 ke aage ke kuch hisse.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line is now two whole strips, each in five equal parts. The parts up to the question mark are coloured: the first strip in full, and some parts past station 1.

why.hi: station 1 = 5/5 hai, aur 3 gap aage 5 + 3 = 8, yaani 8/5, jo 1 aur 3/5 hai
why.en: station 1 is 5/5, and 3 gaps on makes 5 + 3 = 8 gaps: 8/5, which is 1 and 3/5

whyShort.hi: 1 = 5/5, aur 3 gap aage 8/5
whyShort.en: 1 is 5/5, and 3 gaps on is 8/5

whyAlt.hi: station 2 se ulta gino: 2 = 10/5, aur train usse 2 gap pehle hai, toh 8/5
whyAlt.en: count back from station 2: 2 is 10/5, and the train is 2 gaps before it, so 8/5

simpler.hi: 1 tak pahunchne mein jitne gap lage, usme 3 aur jodo. Yahi jod fraction ka upar wala number hai.
simpler.en: Take the gaps it takes to reach 1 and add 3 more. That sum is the fraction's top number.

covered.hi: Aakhir mein dekha: upar wala number neeche wale se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai.
covered.en: Last we saw: when the top number is bigger than the bottom one, the fraction comes after 1.

prompt.hi: Ek line 0 se 2 tak hai. 0 aur 1 ke beech 6 marks hain, aur 1 aur 2 ke beech bhi 6, sab barabar doori par. 0 se 9 gap chalo toh kis fraction par pahunchoge?
prompt.en: A line runs from 0 to 2. There are 6 evenly spaced marks between 0 and 1, and 6 more between 1 and 2. Which fraction do you reach after moving 9 gaps from 0?

reask.hi: 0 se 2 ki line par har poore ke andar 6 marks barabar doori par lage hain; 0 se 9 gap chalkar kaunsa fraction aata hai?
reask.en: On a line from 0 to 2, each whole has 6 evenly spaced marks inside it; which fraction do you reach after 9 gaps from 0?

did.hi: 6 marks se gap nikala aur 0 se 9 gap gine
did.en: found each gap from 6 marks and counted 9 gaps from 0

why.hi: 6 marks se har poore ke 7 barabar gaps bante hain, toh har gap 1/7; 0 se 9 gap chalkar 9/7 aata hai, yaani 1 aur 2/7.
why.en: 6 marks make 7 equal gaps in each whole, so each gap is 1/7; 9 gaps from 0 reach 9/7, that is 1 and 2/7.

simpler.hi: Pehle dekho, 0 aur 1 ke beech ke 6 marks se kitne gaps bante hain; wahi ginti neeche wala number hai.
simpler.en: First see how many gaps the 6 marks between 0 and 1 make; that count is the bottom number.

viewCaption.hi: Dekho, 0 se 2 tak ki line ab do poori pattiyan hain, ek ke baad ek, dono saat barabar hisson mein. Ungli 0 par rakho aur hisse ek-ek karke gino.
viewCaption.en: Look, the line from 0 to 2 is now two whole strips end to end, both in seven equal parts. Put a finger on 0 and count the parts one by one.

covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki har fraction ki line par ek pakki jagah hai, jo gaps ginkar milti hai. Jab upar wala number neeche wale number se bada ho, toh fraction 1 ke aage aata hai.
covered.en: Today we saw that every fraction has a fixed place on the line, found by counting gaps. When the top number is bigger than the bottom number, the fraction comes after 1.
